title: Detailed magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <rect x='68' y='62' width='22' height='10' rx='4' fill='#8B5E3C' transform='rotate(45 68 62)'/>
  <rect x='68' y='62' width='22' height='4' rx='2' fill='#C88E5A' transform='rotate(45 68 62)'/>
  <!-- Handle connector -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='58' r='5' fill='#D4A76A'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='58' r='3' fill='#F0C88A'/>
  <!-- Lens rim -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='28' fill='#4A6FA5'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='25' fill='#6B9BD2'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='23' fill='#1A2A4A'/>
  <!-- Lens glass -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='21' fill='#7EC8E3'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='21' fill='#A8E0F0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Lens shine -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='30' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#E8F8FF' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(-30 30 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='48' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#E8F8FF' opacity='0.4' transform='rotate(-30 45 48)'/>
  <!-- Lens reflection arc -->
  <path d='M 25 50 A 18 18 0 0 1 22 32' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2' fill='none' opacity='0.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Rim highlight -->
  <path d='M 20 22 A 26 26 0 0 1 50 14' stroke='#8CB8E8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Small screw details on rim -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='13' r='1.5' fill='#B0C8E8'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#B0C8E8'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='63' r='1.5' fill='#B0C8E8'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#B0C8E8'/>
</svg>
